# GitHub Repository SEO & Optimization Guide (2026)

This guide documents the repository SEO settings, keywords, topics, and backlink strategies applied to **[Almog787/Global-calculator-pro](https://github.com/Almog787/Global-calculator-pro)** to maximize search engine rankings, domain authority, and developer discovery.

---

## 📌 1. Repository Header Settings (About Section)

Configure these settings in the **About** section (gear icon on the top right of the GitHub repo page):

- **Description (under 160 characters for Google snippet truncation):**
  > `🧮 High-performance open-source online calculator suite & 36+ free embeddable widgets. Decimal.js precision, offline PWA, 6 languages (EN/HE/ES/FR/AR/RU).`

- **Website URL:**

- **Include in Home Page:**
  - ☑️ Releases
  - ☑️ Packages
  - ☑️ Environments

## 🏷️ 2. Recommended GitHub Topics (Tags)

Paste the following keywords into the **Topics** field on GitHub:

```
seo-optimization, calculators, calculator, embeddable-widgets, widgets, financial-tools, mortgage-calculator, compound-interest, pwa, offline-first, typescript, react19, content-generation, decimal-js, i18n, hebrew, arabic, spanish, french, russian, open-source
```

### Why these topics matter:
1. **`seo-optimization` & `content-generation`**: Places the repo into trending developer hubs looking for programmatic content and site-building tools.
2. **`calculators` & `embeddable-widgets`**: Captures search traffic from bloggers and webmasters searching for iframe/React embed tools.
3. **`financial-tools` & `mortgage-calculator`**: Targets high-intent financial search queries.
4. **`pwa` & `offline-first`**: Connects with modern web app architecture communities.

## 🔗 3. Backlink & Anchor Text Architecture

Every link from GitHub's high-DA domain (`DA 96+`) passes valuable SEO juice to `globalcalcpro.com`. We use varied, high-intent anchor text:

- `[Global Calc Pro](https://globalcalcpro.com)` (Brand match)
- `[Mortgage & Loan Amortization Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/mortgage-calculator)` (Keyword exact match)
- `[Free Embeddable Calculator Widgets](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/widgets)` (Feature intent)
- `[Compound Interest & Wealth Planner](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/compound-interest)` (Finance intent)
- `[VAT & Sales Tax Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/calculators/vat)` (Tax intent)

## 🛠️ 4. Automated README Maintenance

Run the automated generator script whenever new calculators are added:

```bash
node scripts/update-readme.js
```

This keeps the README synchronized with all routes, SEO descriptions, and test coverage metrics.
